groups. Compare held selection with structural, likelihood, frequency,
uniform, family-local, and shuffled controls under matched budgets. Use the
difficulty strata only for post-selection evaluation.

   gate_check_summary.

   implementation. Test split leakage, held-label access, missing token

   visible numbers, target, operator, residual magnitude, operand-reuse

   likelihood, summed log likelihood, proposal frequency, uniform legal

   abstention options, and total selection budgets.

   unique reachable-family coverage, forced-prefix continuation success,
   final exact success, abstention, selection time, and total budget by
